nodes.title: Clash Real
widgets_values:
# Clash Real: real-life fights
**Boxing, MMA, Muay Thai, taekwondo, Brazilian jiu-jitsu**: pick a fight style, an arena (ring, cage, dojo, temple courtyard,
rooftop, rain alley...) and press **Run**: one clean technique per shot, shot like a fight film.
**Keyframe mode**: Z-Image paints the **start frame**, one Qwen Image Edit command lands the technique in the **end frame**, and
**LTX-2.5 first+last frame** animates between them with its own audio, so fighters stay separate and strikes connect.
**Full fight**: rig *auto (fight sequence)*, **shot_index** on *increment*, queue 6 runs, then **clash_rig_reel** with count 6.

nodes.title: First frame
widgets_values: **Z-Image Turbo** (8 steps) paints the opening frame the way the rig sees the fight: from the glove, from the floor, from the sky... LTX animates from this frame, so a strong first frame = a strong shot.

nodes.title: End frame
widgets_values: **Qwen Image Edit 2511** (Lightning, 4 steps) applies one edit command to the start frame: the strike lands. Same camera, scene and fighters, a split second later. Open weights.

nodes.title: Motion
widgets_values: **LTX-2.5 22B distilled, first + last frame**, two stages (half-res pass, x2 latent upscale, refine) with the start and end frames as guides and **synchronized audio**. The end guide is soft (strength 0.35) so the move plays out instead of holding the start and snapping to the end.

nodes.title: Impact FX
widgets_values: **Clash FX** adds what a real fight edit adds: hit flashes, camera jolts, chromatic punch, radial speed lines, anime impact frames and speed ramps, using each rig's own defaults. Sliders at -1 follow the rig; strength 0 bypasses it. Frame count never changes, so the LTX audio stays in sync. Both the raw and the FX clip are saved.
